newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart plans to double share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart plans to double share buyback.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc., the nation's largest retailer, said Friday it plans to double its share repurchase programme to $400 million.
The company said it had already acquired about $181 million in stock under this programme.
Purchases will be made from time to time in the open market and shares will be used in the company's stock option and other benefit plans, the company said.
The shares repurchased represent less than 1 percent of the roughly 2.3 billion shares outstanding, the company said.
Bentonville, Ark.-based Wal-Mart's stock rose 25 cents to $24.75 early on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was among the most active issues.
